 Yoodlee Films Hosts Star-Studded Special Screening for Upcoming Comedy ‘Party Animals’ Amid Laughter and High-Energy Vibes!
 Cine Reporter November 19, 2026 
 Yoodlee Films rolled out the red carpet for a special screening of its upcoming comedy, Party Animals, gathering members of the entertainment industry for an evening packed with humour, high spirits, and unfiltered chaos. Helmed by director Ravi Chhabriya, the film features Viraj Ghelani, Arjun Tanwar, Pragati Nagpal, Jaanya Joshi, Naqiyah Haji, and Soundous Moufakir in key roles.
 Set against the backdrop of Mumbai’s party scene on New Year’s Eve, Party Animals follows a group of young individuals navigating friendship, relationships, insecurities and the chaos that comes with a night that refuses to go as planned. Blending quirky humour with relatable moments, the film captures the unpredictability of youth, the pressure of FOMO and the madness that unfolds when a group of friends comes together for one unforgettable night.
 The evening was graced by the film’s cast, including Manoj Joshi, Kamlesh Sawant, Samir Soni, Suresh Menon, Viraj Ghelani, Arjun Tanwar, Pragati Nagpal, Naqiyah Haji, Soundous Moufakir, Anil Charanjeett, Saqib Ayub along with director Ravi Chhabriya and producers Vikram Mehra and Siddharth Anand Kumar.
 The screening also witnessed the presence of several celebrities and members of the film fraternity, including Ranvir Shorey, Sunil Grover, Mika Singh, Manjot Singh, Aarya Babbar, Gurdeep Mehndi, Abhishek Bajaj, Shivangi Joshi, Helly Shah, Poonam Pandey, Jamie Lever, Jessey Lever, and many more, who came together to celebrate the film. The evening saw the attendees enjoy the film’s quirky take on friendship, relationships and the unpredictable twists of a night out, making it a memorable celebration ahead of its theatrical release.
 Directed by Ravi Chhabriya and produced by Vikram Mehra and Siddharth Anand Kumar under the banner of Yoodlee Films, Party Animals features Viraj Ghelani as Mann Patel and Arjun Tanwar as Armaan Khanna, alongside Pragati Nagpal, Naqiyah Haji, Alam Khan, Saqib Ayub, Kamlesh Sawant, Anil Charanjeett, Aaron Koul, Vijay Patkar and Manoj Joshi. Written by Ali Haji, Khush Mullick and Veer Panchal, the film brings together friendship, terrible judgement and escalating madness in a party comedy that mainstream Hindi cinema has relatively rarely explored.
 By Keerti Kadam
